source:
@@U04274@@
It’s murderous, the weight. Can't lift it, can’t carry it.

@@U04276@@
Duck down, then. Stoop, I said! I'll heave it onto your back!

@@U04278@@
Au! Ouch! Now you've done it! It's broke my back in two!

@@U04279@@
(The chest falls and bursts open.)

@@U04281@@
All that gold lying in a heap! Hurry, pick it up!

@@U04283@@
Put it in my apron! There'll still be plenty.

@@U04285@@
There, that'll do! Hurry!

@@U04286@@
(She rises to her feet.)

@@U04287@@
Oh, no! The apron’s got a hole! Every step you take you waste more treasure!

@@U04289@@
(Of our Emperor.)

@@U04290@@
What’s going on here! You've no right! Scrounging the Emperor's treasures!
translation:
@@U04274@@
这是致命的，重量。举不起来，拎不起来。

@@U04276@@
那就趴下吧弯腰，我说！我会把它放到你的背上！

@@U04278@@
啊！哎哟!现在你已经做到了！它把我的背折成了两半！

@@U04279@@
（箱子掉落并爆开。）

@@U04281@@
所有的金子都堆成一堆！快点，捡起来吧！

@@U04283@@
把它放进我的围裙里吧！还是会有很多的

@@U04285@@
就这样，就可以了！匆忙！

@@U04286@@
（她站起来。）

@@U04287@@
哦，不！围裙破了一个洞！你每走一步，就会浪费更多的财富！

@@U04289@@
（我们的皇帝。）

@@U04290@@
这是怎么回事！你没有权利！掠夺皇帝的宝藏！
